menu_option_descriptions.authorization: Manage RFID access and Home Assistant remote starts separately.
menu_option_descriptions.confirm_ap_mode: Enable the charger's setup Wi-Fi; this disconnects Home Assistant.

general.title: General settings
general.description: These settings affect Home Assistant. Charging strategy and authorization mode are dedicated device controls.

authorization.title: Local charging authorisation
authorization.description: Stored RFID identifiers: {count}. Physical card access and starts initiated by Home Assistant are managed independently. This does not change the charger's authorization mode, cards, or cloud bindings.

data.restrict_authorization: Restrict RFID access to the allowlist

data_description.restrict_authorization: Enables local checking of physical RFID identifiers. An enabled empty list rejects every card.
data_description.allow_ha_remote_start: Allows starts through HA controls, services, and automations. No technical identifier needs to be added to the RFID list.
data_description.authorized_id_tags: Up to 100 exact OCPP identifiers of 1–20 characters. The list is stored locally and shown again when this dialog opens. Delete a line to remove it; identifiers are omitted from normal logs and diagnostics.

command_outcome_uncertain.message: The outcome of command {command_name} ({command_id}) is uncertain: {status} ({details}).

state.details: Retains the most recent actual Faulted event after the charger recovers. OCPP StatusNotification and Growatt faultmessage details belonging to the same event are combined.
The latest terminal queue result; use Command ID to correlate repeated automation actions.

Approximate time with actual energy transfer, accumulated from transaction MeterValues above 100 W. Energy-counter increases are used when power is unavailable; long reporting gaps are excluded. Historical sessions recorded before this feature remain unavailable.

PV Linkage cannot be selected while the charger reports PowerMeterFailure/485 Fault or after three consecutive external-meter requests receive no usable response. One or two temporary timeouts do not block the mode.
The operating mode controls which settings apply. Load balancing is available in Fast and Off-Peak mode, but not in PV Linkage mode.
Shows how charging sessions are authorized: Home Assistant/RFID, RFID only, or Plug & charge.
PV Linkage may supplement solar power with the configured grid allowance. PV Linkage+ uses only solar surplus. Manual and Smart Boost may still draw grid power.

solar_grid_import_limit.name: Sporočeni odjem iz omrežja za PV Linkage

state.details: Maximum grid power the charger may add in PV Linkage mode. The retained value is not an active regular grid allowance in PV Linkage+. The charger requires about 1.4 kW single-phase or 4.1 kW three-phase to start.
Manual boost uses configured time windows; Smart boost uses target energy and finish time. The charger returns to PV Linkage after the boost.

grid_off_peak_charging.name: Polnjenje iz omrežja po nizki tarifi

state.details: Allows grid charging in the configured off-peak windows when Plug & charge authorization is active.
Enables charging during the configured off-peak windows in Off-Peak mode.
Lists the shared charger-side time windows. Depending on the working mode, Growatt uses them for Off-Peak charging or PV Linkage Manual Boost.
Charging current used during the configured off-peak windows.
External Modbus meter model used for grid measurements.
Modbus address of the external meter used for grid measurements.
Power meter uses direct Modbus measurements; CT modes use current transformers. Growatt calls the OCPP field 'wring', likely a vendor typo.
After full charge, the charger may continue supplying a compatible EV for cabin or battery preheating and defrosting. Behavior depends on vehicle support.
Vendor charging delay in seconds. 0 means no delay. Random Delay behavior may vary by charger firmware.

Applies the complete changed PV Boost draft to the charger. Manual Boost sends its time window; Smart Boost sends finish time and target energy. The action is available only when the draft is complete, differs from the reported settings, and the charger is idle in PV Linkage mode.
Sets the grid-load limit used by load balancing. Available only with the Fast and Off-Peak charging strategies; unavailable in PV Linkage modes.
Modbus address of the external meter. Available only when Power meter is selected as the external sampling method and no charging transaction is active.

solar_grid_import_limit.name: Odjem iz omrežja za PV Linkage

state.details: Available only in PV Linkage mode, where regular grid import is allowed. It is unavailable in PV Linkage+, which uses solar surplus only. Decimal values are sent using dot notation.
Target energy for Smart Boost. This edits the local draft and is sent together with the finish time only after Apply is pressed.
PV Linkage allows the configured regular grid import; PV Linkage+ uses solar surplus only. Manual and Smart Boost may still draw grid power. Existing Boost targets and time windows are not changed.

Selects direct Modbus meter measurements or a CT 2000:1/3000:1 current transformer. Available only while no charging transaction is active. Growatt calls the OCPP key 'G_ExternalSamplingCurWring', likely a vendor typo.
Selects the external Modbus meter model. Available only when Power meter is selected as the external sampling method and no charging transaction is active.
Selects which Boost workflow to stage locally. Manual exposes a time window; Smart exposes finish time and target energy. No charger write occurs until Apply is pressed.
Prevents the configured grid-load limit from being exceeded. Available only with the Fast and Off-Peak charging strategies; unavailable in PV Linkage modes.
Allows a compatible vehicle to continue drawing power for preheating or defrosting after reaching full charge. Vehicle support is required.
Start of the staged Manual Boost window. Press Apply to send the complete window.
End of the staged Manual Boost window. Press Apply to send the complete window.
Requested Smart Boost finish time. A time already passed today is scheduled for tomorrow when Apply is pressed.
